title: Detect current focus task from LOG.md
description: Read the last in-progress entry from LOG.md and cross-reference with tasks.json to return the full Task object as the current focus task. Returns null if no active task.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns correct Task object when LOG.md has an active 'in-progress' entry
Returns null when LOG.md is empty
Returns null when all tasks in LOG.md are complete
Cross-references task ID from LOG.md with tasks.json for full task data

steps.details: export async function getCurrentTask(agentDir: string, tasks: Task[]): Promise<Task | null> { const activity = await readRecentActivity(agentDir, 10); const inProgress = activity.filter(a => a.outcome === 'in-progress'); if (inProgress.length === 0) return null; const lastActive = inProgress[inProgress.length - 1]; return tasks.find(t => t.id === lastActive.taskId) || null }
In status.ts, call getCurrentTask(agentDir, tasks) and pass result to StatusDashboard as currentTask prop.
